node.label: Poor gross motor coordination
node.definition: An abnormality of the ability (skills) to perform a precise movement of large muscles with the intent to perform a specific act. Gross motor skills are required to mediate movements of the arms, legs, and other large body parts.

diseases.label: neurodevelopmental disorder with coarse facies and mild distal skeletal abnormalities
